request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:CAPTAIN

layers.text: A small colour change only: his light green skin (face, ears, arms, hands) becomes one step darker and duller, a dull dark moss green, colour #5a7038 with #3a4a26 shadows; still clearly green, a mid-tone, not black, and the face stays clearly visible. Do not touch his helmet or clothes. Keep everything else exactly the same: the steel horned helmet, tusks, open mouth, the brown hide cape and leather tunic, the tin megaphone, belt, boots, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style.
